comments.author: Igor
comments.body: I got this quest without having done 'The King and The Elephant' or the Ivory Pipe quest.

comments.author: Wright
comments.body:
Jap wiki and ivyro have been updated with "The King and The Elephant" being a prequest for this but it seems it's not the case. The information ingame also contradicts the wikias as it states that this quest has "Search for the African Elephant" as its prequest. So I don't really know where "The King and the Elephant" falls in this group. It's either a mistake in the wikias or a bug in the game if it is indeed the prequest for this.

My advice would be to try to get this quest after getting the African elephants.
